item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las dar rabs srid gsum zil gnon
item.coloph: dar rabs srid gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba/ gtor zlog drag po'i cha lags su (lag tu/)slob dpon pad mas legs bkod nas/ stang chen thugs kyi bcud las bstim/ phyi rabs gang zag don ched du/ las ldan gshen la brgyud pa yi/ mi nub bstan pa'i srog shing du/ phyogs bcu dar rgyas 'phel par shog/
